# Deployment/web
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          readinessProbe:
            # A path that answers 200 once the app can serve requests.
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3

# CronJob/report
spec:
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
            - name: report
              # Starting points: adjust them to what the container uses.
              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: 100m
                  memory: 128Mi
                limits:
                  memory: 256Mi

# Replaces Ingress/shop
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: shop
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: traefik
      namespace: kube-system
  hostnames:
    - "shop.example.test"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: "/"
      backendRefs:
        - name: web
          port: 80
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: Exact
            value: "/health"
      backendRefs:
        - name: web
          port: 80

# Deployment/web
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          # Starting points: adjust them to what the container uses.
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              memory: 256Mi
